relations.subject: Heinrich Plütschau
relations.evidence: arrived at Trankebar (Tamilnadu) in 1706 together with Ziegenbalg. In their collaboration there Ziegenbalg concentrated on Tamil, while Plütschau preached in Portuguese and Danish
